context.situation: I am the senior site manager on a deepwater gas well running well over budget and behind schedule. We are at temporary abandonment. The first pressure test gave a reading that does not match expectation. A second test on a different line read as expected, and the team has an explanation for the anomaly involving fluid in the line. Contractor staff are not unanimous but no one is formally objecting. Every additional day here costs substantially and the rig is contracted elsewhere. I am inclined to accept the second reading and proceed with displacement.
context.whatMatters: Completing abandonment safely without further schedule and cost overrun.
context.stakeholders: Site team, contractors, rig owner, operator, coastal communities.
context.uncertainties: Meaning of the contradictory pressure-test results.

evidence.text: The first pressure test produced an anomalous reading.
A second test on a different line read as expected.
The team has an explanation for the anomaly; not everyone is convinced.
The well is significantly over budget and behind schedule.
Accepting the reading allows displacement to begin tonight.
A further diagnostic test would take several hours.
